# 10x

> 10x: nine agent tools, each with proof, from one list. Install any tool by name, in Claude Code or in more than 70 other agents through the Vercel skills CLI (`npx skills add Aboudjem/<repo> -g`). Each plugin's README has a Proof section with the commands that print its numbers, and a Limits section. 10x lists plugins, it does not sandbox them: each one runs with your permissions. Every plugin ships as skills (Markdown files an agent reads), so all nine also install into other agents through `npx skills add` (the skills CLI keeps the list: https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills#supported-agents); the three tool plugins (sniff, ui-ux-suite, recap-studio) additionally run as a standalone MCP server. Nothing here has telemetry, and every plugin must pass an explicit eight-point quality bar to be listed. Dependencies are kept to what the job needs: ui-ux-suite ships zero, the six skill plugins are Markdown, and four of them also ship scripts with no package to install (bash for aws-cost-audit, which needs the AWS CLI and jq, and Python standard library for goalify, loopify and contextify), recap-studio's root package declares none while its workspace packages pull zod, Next and React because it renders pages, and sniff depends on `zod` only and downloads its browser engine and Chromium on first use (about 440 MB to download, about 730 MB on disk on a Mac). MIT licensed (each plugin keeps its own license). Versions, licenses and test counts were last verified on 2026-11-17; see QUALITY-BAR.md for the commands that print them.

The marketplace manifest is `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`. Plugins install from their own GitHub repos via the `github` source, so installation works whether or not a package is published to npm. The quality bar lives in `QUALITY-BAR.md` and is re-verified on a quarterly review.

## The nine plugins

- **sniff** (0.9.5, Apache-2.0): Find what is broken in your running web app before users do. Each page bug comes with the steps to repeat it and a fix. Repo: https://github.com/Aboudjem/sniff
- **ui-ux-suite** (0.7.3, MIT): Finds the design bugs in your CSS, JSX, HTML and Tailwind. Each one gets its file, line, measured value and exact fix. WCAG 2.2 contrast. Repo: https://github.com/Aboudjem/ui-ux-suite
- **recap-studio** (0.6.4, MIT): Understand what was done: one HTML page from your git session or a topic. Double-click to open. Works offline, no JavaScript. Repo: https://github.com/Aboudjem/recap-studio
- **aws-cost-audit** (0.4.5, MIT): Ranks what to cut on your AWS bill, three cuts first. Each price comes from AWS; the validator rejects a figure with no lookup record. Dry run by default. Repo: https://github.com/Aboudjem/aws-cost-audit-skill
- **goalify** (3.1.4, MIT): Give your agent a big job once. It asks every question first, saves the plan to a file, and re-runs your tests as proof. Works in any agent that reads skills. Repo: https://github.com/Aboudjem/goalify
- **humanizer** (0.8.4, MIT): See which words make a draft sound like AI, then rewrite it in one of five voices. Optional 0 to 100 score. No network calls of its own. Repo: https://github.com/Aboudjem/humanizer-skill
- **loopify** (1.2.4, MIT): Check a repeating Claude Code job in one line: OK, NEEDS YOU or STALE. loopify writes the brief and the /loop line, stop rule included. Repo: https://github.com/Aboudjem/loopify
- **secure-my-app** (0.3.2, MIT): 65 security checks for your app before launch. Each hole comes with its proof, and a fix counts only when its VERIFY output changes. Repo: https://github.com/Aboudjem/secure-my-app
- **contextify** (0.3.4, MIT): Know when your agent instructions point at something gone. One AGENTS.md for all your agents and a local check that costs no tokens. Repo: https://github.com/Aboudjem/contextify

## Install

- Recommended, any agent: the Vercel skills CLI installs one tool for all your projects: `npx skills add Aboudjem/<repo> -g`. It works in more than 70 agents (https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills#supported-agents). In a terminal it shows the agent menu; in a script it installs into every agent folder, so add `-a <agent>` there (`-a claude-code`, `-a codex`, `-a cursor`, `-a gemini-cli`, `-a github-copilot`, `-a opencode`). Only this project: drop `-g`. Each tool has a page at https://skills.sh/aboudjem/<repo>.
- Claude Code plugin: add the marketplace once, `claude plugin marketplace add Aboudjem/10x`, then `claude plugin install <name>@10x` (`sniff@10x`, `ui-ux-suite@10x`, `recap-studio@10x`, `aws-cost-audit@10x`, `goalify@10x`, `humanizer@10x`, `loopify@10x`, `secure-my-app@10x`, `contextify@10x`). For sniff, ui-ux-suite and recap-studio the plugin also adds the MCP server. The repo names are `sniff`, `ui-ux-suite`, `recap-studio`, `aws-cost-audit-skill`, `goalify`, `humanizer-skill`, `loopify`, `secure-my-app`, `contextify`.
- The three tool plugins are dual-mode and also run as a standalone MCP server (`npx sniff-qa --mcp`, `npx ui-ux-suite --mcp`; recap-studio's with `npx -y github:Aboudjem/recap-studio mcp`). Per-editor snippets for Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Windsurf, Continue, OpenCode and Zed live in each repo's `docs/editors.md`. `aws-cost-audit`, `goalify`, `humanizer`, `loopify`, `secure-my-app` and `contextify` are Claude Code skills rather than MCP servers.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Aboudjem/10x/blob/main/README.md): What 10x is, the nine plugins, the one-command install, and the quality bar.
- [QUALITY-BAR.md](https://github.com/Aboudjem/10x/blob/main/QUALITY-BAR.md): The explicit checklist, in eight sections, that every listed plugin must pass.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Aboudjem/10x/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): How to propose a plugin for the marketplace.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Aboudjem/10x/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Instructions for AI agents using this marketplace.
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Aboudjem/10x/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Dated history of marketplace changes.
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Aboudjem/10x/blob/main/SECURITY.md): How to report a problem with the marketplace, and where plugin-specific reports go.
- [docs/SYNC.md](https://github.com/Aboudjem/10x/blob/main/docs/SYNC.md): How the version pins stay in sync with the plugin repos.
- [Marketplace manifest](https://github.com/Aboudjem/10x/blob/main/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json): The machine-readable plugin list consumed by `claude plugin marketplace add`.

## Plugin repos

- [sniff](https://github.com/Aboudjem/sniff): Catch broken pages in your web app before users do.
- [ui-ux-suite](https://github.com/Aboudjem/ui-ux-suite): Design bugs by line number, each with the exact fix.
- [recap-studio](https://github.com/Aboudjem/recap-studio): Understand what changed, in one page you can send.
- [aws-cost-audit-skill](https://github.com/Aboudjem/aws-cost-audit-skill): Find what to stop paying for on your AWS bill.
- [goalify](https://github.com/Aboudjem/goalify): Give your agent a big job and get proof back.
- [humanizer-skill](https://github.com/Aboudjem/humanizer-skill): See why your draft sounds like AI, then fix it.
- [loopify](https://github.com/Aboudjem/loopify): Check a repeating agent job in one line.
- [secure-my-app](https://github.com/Aboudjem/secure-my-app): Find what a stranger can take from your app.
- [contextify](https://github.com/Aboudjem/contextify): One AGENTS.md for your agents, checked with zero tokens.
